description:
> *This was generated by AI from the defk-2mz design session (2026-10-12).*

## Agent Brief

**Category:** enhancement
**Summary:** Facts from conditions and raising guards, so defk-9za's and defk-siy's second loop's checks drop, raising guards become the documented way to state preconditions, and the report names the missing fact.

**Design:** docs/adr/0007-symbolic-bounds.md; docs/research/relational-facts.md sections 3, 4, 6 (9za, siy loop 2), 7 (the report) and 8 (step 3). Glossary: **Raising guard** in CONTEXT.md.

**Desired behavior:**
- Narrowing in `if`/`cond` arms (statement and value), `for` filters and the right operand of `and`; later `cond` arms see earlier conditions' negations when those are conjunctions; non-empty ranges give `s <= e` in the body.
- Raising guards: after `if c, do: <raises>`, the rest of the block sees `not c`.
- Soundness rules: an arm that used its own condition to drop a check is never compiled as a select; a condition narrows only from operands computed without a check a flagged strip could run on past.
- The report: when a half of a bounds check fails and the best residual has at most two atoms and no product, "nothing proves i - w < len(x) (it would follow from w >= 0)"; otherwise today's text.
- docs/language.md: a section recommending raising guards for preconditions on arguments, with a tested example. Rewrite `decode16`'s `_ = alloc(u8, if(c, do: 0, else: -1))` trick (examples/codecs.exs) as a raising guard, with the report's check counts before and after.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- [ ] defk-9za's kernel and defk-siy's loop 2 kernel (with `m >= 0` established) compile with no bounds checks; without the guard the report names `w >= 0` / `m >= 0`
- [ ] A test that a guarded arm is not turned into a select, and one for the flagged-strip operand rule (coordinate with defk-5qk if it has landed: a guard on a strip-assigned value must not make a flagged access fixed)
- [ ] Agreement under forced yields; soundness properties for narrowing
- [ ] `mix test`, `mix docs`, `mix credo --strict` clean; close defk-9za and defk-siy

**Out of scope:** `case` guards, `or` in a taken branch, `!=`, products (step 4)

comments.text: Owner 2026-10-17: the symbolic-bounds chain may cost at most about +15% compiler time in total, against the time before step 1 (clang not included). Steps 1-2 used about 7% (u1u +2.4%, qdz +4.6%; provisional). Record the ceiling in ADR-0007 (Consequences: Cost) in this ticket's PR, and report this step's cost and the total against it.

PR #30 (https://github.com/DanielLuning/defk/pull/30). 9za and siy loop 2 check-free; report hint in; select and strip rules tested. Cost +5.0% (chain ~+12.4% of 15% ceiling, provisional). Close defk-b38, defk-9za, defk-siy after merge.

title: Symbolic bounds: facts from conditions and raising guards, and the report's missing-fact hint
